title: Confusoside, a dihydrochalcone glucoside, prevents acetaminophen-induced liver injury by modulating the Nrf2/NF-kappaB/caspase signaling pathway.
authors: Zhao, Jinghao; Shi, Shang; Zhang, Xiaoyu; Liu, Yaping; Yuan, Minglong; Cheng, Guiguang; Wang, Yudan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物Confusoside对药物性肝损伤的保护作用，仅涉及小分子与Keap1蛋白的分子对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无结合位点预测或互作机制建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Dihydrochalcones are important bioactive ingredients in plants. Anneslea fragrans is an edible and medicinal plant, and its leaves are rich in dihydrochalcones. Confusoside (CF) is the most abundant dihydrochalcone in A. fragrans leaves, which is traditionally used in the treatment of liver diseases. The aim of this study was to investigate the hepatoprotective effect of CF on acetaminophen (APAP)-induced hepatic injury in mice. CF could reduce the levels of AST, ALT, and LDH in the serum and enhance the antioxidant activity by activating the Nrf2 signaling pathway to increase the activities of antioxidant enzymes (SOD and CAT), and the GSH content but decrease the MDA accumulation in liver tissues. Immunofluorescence assay and western blotting analysis showed that CF can regulate Nrf2 into the cell nucleus, thereby promoting the expression of downstream antioxidant-related proteins, including NQO1 and HO-1. In addition, CF could inhibit the liver inflammatory response by suppressing the activation of the NF-kappaB signaling pathway to reduce the expressions of TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, IL-6, and NO. Molecular docking results showed that there was good binding between the CF and Keap1-Nrf2 protein. Western blotting and TUNEL analysis also revealed CF-inhibited cell apoptosis-related protein expression (Bcl2 and caspase-3/9 proteins). Thus, the CF from A. fragrans leaves could be served as an alternative hepaprotective agent for the treatment and prevention of APAP-induced liver injury.
abstract_zh: 二氢查尔酮是植物中的重要生物活性成分。香叶树（Anneslea fragrans）是一种可食用且具有药用价值的植物，其叶片富含二氢查尔酮。Confusoside（CF）是香叶树叶片中含量最丰富的二氢查尔酮，传统上用于治疗肝脏疾病。本研究旨在探讨CF对对乙酰氨基酚（APAP）诱导的小鼠肝损伤的保护作用。CF能够降低血清中AST、ALT和LDH的水平，并通过激活Nrf2信号通路增强抗氧化活性，提高抗氧化酶（SOD和CAT）的活性及GSH含量，同时减少肝脏组织中MDA的积累。免疫荧光实验和蛋白质印迹分析表明，CF可调控Nrf2进入细胞核，从而促进下游抗氧化相关蛋白（包括NQO1和HO-1）的表达。此外，CF通过抑制NF-kappaB信号通路的激活，减少TNF-alpha、IL-1beta、IL-6和NO的表达，从而抑制肝脏炎症反应。分子对接结果显示，CF与Keap1-Nrf2蛋白之间存在良好的结合。蛋白质印迹和TUNEL分析还揭示，CF抑制了细胞凋亡相关蛋白的表达（Bcl2和caspase-3/9蛋白）。因此，来自香叶树叶片的CF可作为替代性保肝剂，用于治疗和预防APAP诱导的肝损伤。
